name: Independent Contractor Agreement
description: A company engages an individual or business as an independent contractor, not an employee.

fields.label: Compensation basis
fields.help: For example: per hour, per day, fixed fee.

fields.label: End date
fields.help: Leave blank for an open-ended engagement.

sections.title: Parties
sections.text: This Independent Contractor Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of {{effective_date}} between {{company_name}}, located at {{company_address}} (the "Company"), and {{contractor_name}}, located at {{contractor_address}} (the "Contractor").

sections.title: Services
sections.text: The Contractor shall provide the following services (the "Services"): {{scope_of_work}}. The Contractor decides the method, details and means of performing the Services.

sections.title: Term
sections.text: The engagement begins on {{start_date}} and continues until {{end_date}} or, if no end date is stated, until terminated under this Agreement.

sections.title: Compensation
sections.text: The Company shall pay the Contractor {{compensation_amount}} {{currency}} {{compensation_basis}}. The Contractor shall submit invoices and the Company shall pay undisputed amounts within 30 days of receipt.

sections.title: Independent Contractor Status
sections.text: The Contractor is an independent contractor and not an employee, partner or agent of the Company. The Contractor is responsible for all taxes, insurance and benefits relating to the Contractor's own compensation and personnel, and is not entitled to Company employee benefits.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.text: Work product created by the Contractor specifically for the Company under this Agreement is owned by the Company upon payment, and the Contractor assigns all rights in it to the Company. The Contractor retains ownership of pre-existing materials and grants the Company a non-exclusive license to use them as part of the work product.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.text: The Contractor shall keep confidential all non-public information of the Company and use it only to perform the Services. This obligation survives termination.

sections.title: Termination
sections.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement on {{termination_notice_days}} days' written notice. The Company shall pay for Services satisfactorily performed up to the termination date.

sections.title: General
sections.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}. It is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject matter and may be amended only in writing signed by both parties.
